notes.note: Reviewed the Windows packaged-upgrade fixture repair and POSIX shell-oracle correction against the unchanged production UI proxy exclusion case and its real HTTP assertions. Changes are isolated install-root ACL setup, scheduler/trust command fixture routing, native installer fixtures and scheduling-guidance argv checks; the outside OAuth/MCP/well-known exclusion implementation and its mutation fallback test are unchanged. The Windows full owner executed that proxy exclusion case without failure, while separately disclosing the remaining lifecycle/readiness failures. Historical R3 client captures were not rerun; this note does not requalify clients, release exposure, or later Connections UI. No prose change warranted for either citing document.
